mapper.select: SELECT t3.place_id AS placeId, t3.place_name AS placeName, t3.place_discription AS placeDiscription, t3.support_available AS supportAvailable, t3.seating_capacity AS seatingCapacity, t3.place_note AS placeNote, t3.hidden_flg AS hiddenFlg FROM m_lms_user t LEFT OUTER JOIN t_user_place t2 ON t.lms_user_id = t2.lms_user_id AND t.delete_flg = #{deleteFlg} LEFT OUTER JOIN m_place t3 ON t2.place_id = t3.place_id WHERE t.lms_user_id = #{lmsUserId} AND t3.hidden_flg = #{hiddenFlg;
